title: PGT Teacher (Computer Science/ICT & Mathematics)
age_limit: Maximum age of 55 years as on 25 November 2026
summary: EdCIL (India) Limited invites online applications on behalf of the Ministry of Education and Skills Development, Royal Government of Bhutan, for the recruitment of Indian PGT teachers in Computer Science/ICT and Mathematics on a contract basis for higher secondary schools in Bhutan. The posting tenure is for a minimum of two years with a consolidated gross remuneration of Rs. 1,40,000 per month.
eligibility_bullets: Master's Degree in the relevant field from a recognized university with at least 60% marks.
B.Ed. degree is preferable for Computer Science/ICT and mandatory for Mathematics.
Minimum 5 years of work experience in teaching relevant subjects for grades 7 to 12.
Maximum age limit is 55 years as on 25 November 2026 with no age relaxation.
High proficiency in teaching in the English language and use of technology for education.
how_to_apply_steps: Visit the official EdCIL teacher recruitment website and access the online application form.
Register using a valid personal email ID and fill in all required personal and educational details.
Scan and upload a recent passport-size photograph and signature as per specified format and size guidelines.
Submit the application online and retain the generated login credentials and application printout for future steps.
